notes.title: The Demo is Live!
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p]It's been some time coming but the demo is finally here! Thank you to everyone who takes the time to try out the game <3[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest is now live
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome,

Thank you for your interest in play testing Boggie Fungi, to do so simply request access and most should simply be accepted to participate.

Do remember to leave your feedback for the game, in this first round I am looking to know generalities of the game feel and pace, the game doesn't have a tutorial so I am also expecting to see some questions regarding progression around here. And if you really want to be a GOAT please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLScDW0cGD53pSJoJ9XXZrTGNrxITipvpd2x0ZcW0MbcFGtfctg%2Fviewform%3Fusp%3Ddialog]answer this form[/url] as that would give me a better understanding of how the game is perceived.

Besides that, I am keeping the feedback open to let everyone who participates so share your thoughts and first impressions in the forum!

Again, thank you for participating, this is a solo dev game so any help is appreciated. Also if you haven't yet do wishlist the game or share with a friend who you think would enjoy Boggie Fungi.

See you in the forums,
Karanva the one who draws with woobly lines
